purpose: Teach: 誓っ/ぎっしり/ノルマ/砂浜/ダメージ/贈っ/学芸/あ〜

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、優勝するって誓っていたぜ
lines.en: Riku — you swore you were going to win.
lines.style: Watching him carefully, tone caught between calling him out and giving him space. Soft on the name. The cadence of someone who remembers what was promised.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のロッカー、教科書ぎっしりだな、桜
lines.en: Your locker's packed solid with textbooks, Sakura.
lines.style: Turning it back on her, half-smirk in the voice. Light, observant. Not accusing — noticing. The cool-distance deflection of someone who doesn't want to be looked at too closely.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のバイトのノルマ、きついらしいな
lines.en: I heard your job quota's pretty brutal, Riku.
lines.style: Matching his tone but softer underneath. Calling him out the way friends do — direct, without preamble. She's checking on him without making it obvious.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族と砂浜に行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You went to the beach with your family, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Curious, almost gentle. Testing whether she'll let him in on something real. The careful question of someone who notices things but doesn't push.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のスマホ、ダメージあるぜ
lines.en: Your phone's pretty beat up, Riku.
lines.style: Short, observant, with a hint of amusement. Noticing the damage like she's cataloguing evidence. Matter-of-fact but not unkind.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、彼女にお誕生日プレゼント、贈ったんだろ?桜
lines.en: You gave your girlfriend a birthday gift, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Teasing with real warmth underneath. Raising the stakes slightly — seeing if she'll react. The kind of knowing that comes from paying attention to someone over time.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、学芸会で活躍したな
lines.en: You really showed up in the school play, Riku.
lines.style: Genuine praise, delivered without fanfare. Warm but not gushy. The tone of someone saying something they mean and trusting him to hear it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、あ〜、もう授業始まるぜ、桜
lines.en: Ah — class is about to start, Sakura.
lines.style: Pulling away, using the time pressure as an excuse. Wry acceptance. The moment closing before anything gets too real. Cool distance settling back in.
